notes: Modified cash basis school district; all funds governmental (no business-type). Basic statement lines come from the Statement of Cash Receipts, Disbursements and Changes in Fund Balance - Governmental Funds, Total column (pp5-6). Taxes (25,126,985) split using Statement of Activities general receipts (p2), which add exactly. Non-Revenue Receipts 7,240,508 split into printed fund lines: insurance adjustments 50,866 + other 80,405 (General, p10), 8,480 (Depreciation, p13), sale of property 209,493 (Special Building, p17) and loan proceeds 6,891,264 (QCPUF, p18 / p3) which is in debt_proceeds (printed receipts total includes it). Hidden transfer (attempt 2): the Columbus Educational Facilities Leasing Corp column shows 1,074,477 of Other Local Receipts (Special Building Fund debt service passed to the blended corporation) and 1,074,477 of its own Debt Service; the Statement of Activities (p2) eliminates both (Other Receipts 376,689, Debt Service 4,751,346). Other Local Receipts 1,101,444 was therefore split into 26,967 receipt + 1,074,477 added to transfers_in, and Debt Service 5,825,824 into 4,751,347 + 1,074,477 in transfers_out (the p2 disbursement-side elimination is 1,074,478, a $1 difference in the report). Because of this split, reported_totals (printed 77,049,275 receipts and 70,989,282 disbursements) are each 1,074,477 higher than the sums of the recorded lines; the printed totals are unchanged. transfers_in also includes the printed net 'Transfers In (Out)' 2,619,454 (p6; General Fund column on p6 shows +2,566,454 net, Other Governmental Funds +53,000); the Depreciation Fund shows 2,619,454 transferred from General Fund (p13) while the General Fund schedule (p12) shows only 53,000 out, so the report's own transfers do not net to zero; recorded as printed. Debt Service (4,751,346 after the Leasing Corp elimination) split into principal 3,753,672 and interest/fees 997,674 using the Bond, Special Building and QCPUF fund schedules (pp16-18; $1 rounding put in interest). Intermediate Sources split into 2110 County Fines and Licenses (fines and forfeitures) and ESU receipts (p9). Detail: recorded per-fund budget-and-actual schedules (pp9-19); the combining statements (General Fund components p7, Other Governmental Funds p8) and the county treasurer schedules (pp20-21) were not recorded to avoid double counting. Lines with actual '-' were skipped. General Fund schedule pages 11-12: the group heading on p12 reads 'Student Transportation (Continued)' but lines 3535-3599 are Private & State Categorical (they total 831,420 with 3300 per p6). General Fund disbursements function-coded only (not itemized by object). Several detail subtotals differ by $1-3 from item sums due to rounding in the report (see report_discrepancies). Roll-forward: 23,833,586 + 77,049,274 (sum of lines) - 70,989,282 + 2,619,454 = 32,513,032; after the split: 23,833,586 + 75,974,797 - 69,914,805 + 3,693,931 - 1,074,477 + 6,891,264 (debt proceeds) ... see sums of listed lines. Read pages 1-21 of 21
